docs.text: Africa: Over €1.5 Billion Pledged for Africa's Great Lakes Region At Paris Conference: [RFI] At the close of an international conference in Paris on the Great Lakes region, French President Emmanuel Macron has announced that €1.5 billion has been pledged in aid. Meanwhile the airport in Goma, in the Democratic Republic of Congo, will reopen to humanitarian flights.

The GLRI is restoring and protecting the waters of Ohio. Without this important federal funding, the problems will only get worse and more expensive to solve.

In Indiana, the GLRI funds projects that enhance water quality, preserve habitats, and promote sustainable practices. This tackles urban runoff, agriculture, and industrial discharge pollution, ensuring clean water for residents and supporting industries like agriculture, tourism, and fishing. Federal funding through the GLRI is improving the waters of Ohio, including the restoration and protection of Lake Erie.
Federal funding from the GLRI is critical to restoring the waters of Lake Superior and keeping them clean.
The GLRI is so incredibly important in the fight against emerging issues like PFAS, invasive species, and climate change.
The GLRI is massively important for the recreational fishing and hunting economy in the region!

GLRI funds are assisting organizations like Conservation Resource Alliance to do their vital work in protecting and enhancing waterways and fish and wildlife habitat. This important program needs continued funding.
With Great Lakes Restoration Initiative funding, 1.8 million farmland acres have received assistance for nutrient management actions, reducing pollution and improving the health of our watersheds.
